title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock with Cooldown
summary: Maximize profit from buying and selling one share at a time.
statement: Maximize profit from buying and selling one share at a time. After a sale, wait through the next day before buying again. You may skip any day.

examples.explanation: Wait and make the last trade.
Sell on day 1 and buy again on day 3, using zero-based days.
Skipping every trade beats buying before a fall.

hints: Conceptual: The previous action determines what you can do today.
Directional: Separate holding, just sold, and free-to-buy states.
Implementation: Update all three from the previous day before replacing those values.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
